hero.name: Alejandro Sánchez
hero.tagline: Computer Engineer by education. Building scalable distributed systems with TypeScript, Python & AI daily.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: With a deep foundation in mathematics and software engineering, I specialize in architecting highly scalable, distributed systems using TypeScript, JavaScript, and Python. My expertise lies in high-level system design, performance optimization, and solving complex business logic that standard tools cannot.
about.p2: I view modern software development as an exercise in AI-assisted engineering and architectural orchestration. I leverage technical expertise to guide AI coding agents, rigorously audit generated code for structural integrity, and securely integrate LLMs into enterprise environments.

bullets: Architected and delivered SaaS products for ISO standards auditing—including client-facing applications, internal dashboards, and AI-powered tooling—as part of a small engineering team (3–5 engineers).
Built full-stack features in TypeScript using React, Next.js, and Vite on the frontend with Fastify and Node.js services on the backend.
Integrated LLMs via AWS Bedrock and designed agent orchestration pipelines for document processing, conversational assistants, and automated business workflows.
Deployed and operated distributed services across AWS and GCP, applying event-driven and serverless patterns.
Containerized services with Docker and maintained CI/CD pipelines for reliable, repeatable deployments.
Led migration of a video analytics platform from legacy JavaScript to a strongly-typed TypeScript codebase, reducing runtime errors and improving developer confidence.
Introduced Vite and esbuild into the build pipeline, cutting build times and accelerating development iteration speed.
Partnered with product and design teams to deliver consistent UI behavior across a complex, data-rich surveillance interface.
Led a front-end team building index and ETF analytics tools, setting engineering standards and driving delivery quality.
Implemented shift-left practices—code reviews, linting, and automated testing—to catch defects early in the development cycle.
Drove front-end scalability across multiple web applications, establishing shared component patterns and consistent architecture.
Contributed across the stack, delivering UI features in TypeScript and supporting backend API work in Python.
Built and maintained financial applications for index construction and ETF analytics across frontend, backend, and data layers.
Designed asynchronous event-processing workflows using RabbitMQ to handle data ingestion reliably at scale.
Developed REST APIs and backend services in Python and Node.js, backed by PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
Built full-stack internal systems for registration, traceability, and collaborator lifecycle management using Python and Node.js.
Developed front-end interfaces and backend services to support business operations and data tracking workflows.
Deployed and operated services on Linux servers with NGINX as a reverse proxy.
Built Python automation tools for data processing, including search and filtering workflows over large Excel datasets.
Delivered custom scripts and utilities to streamline repetitive business operations for clients.
